[中文]
生成一张“杠精视角看 AI 效率神话”的讽刺编辑海报：主标题“你说效率翻倍，我问需求改了几遍？”，使用夸张对话气泡、红色批注、黑白报纸拼贴与醒目黄色高亮，明确为幽默虚构观点，不攻击真实个人或群体。

[English]
Create a satirical editorial poster titled “You say AI doubled productivity; I ask how many times the brief changed.” Use exaggerated speech bubbles, red annotations, black-and-white newspaper collage, and bold yellow highlights. Keep it fictional and humorous, targeting no real person or protected group.
